messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content: 在這種理想情況下（忽略空氣阻力），物體受到的加速度是重力加速度，約為 \(-9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\)（負號表示方向向下）。因此，無論你以多快的初速度把球往上拋，球在上升過程中的加速度始終是 \(-9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\)。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want the acceleration? Actually they ask: "What acceleration will it reach?" But maybe they mean what maximum height? The question: "If a ball is thrown upward at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it reach?" That seems wrong: acceleration due to gravity is constant -9.8 m/s^2 downward. So maybe they mis-asked. We need to respond: The acceleration is due to gravity, about -9.8 m/s^2 downward. Or we can compute maximum height using the function. But the function calculates maximum height given initial velocity and gravity. The user didn't ask for maximum height. They asked for acceleration. So we should answer: acceleration is constant -9.8 m/s^2 downward. No need to call function.
